d3969db91f54bcfdf605.text: Every day we are bombarded with different information coming from various sources like social media, TV, newspapers, and others. But are you aware which of those are facts, and which are opinion ? This module will help you understand and distinguish whether those assertions are facts or opinion.

757a789ce0d681bde8c3.text: A fact is a specific detail that can be proven as true based on objective evidence.

9f06d738a0b593dc2f5a.text: Objective proof can be one or more of the following: physical evidence, an

26566695d9b15a2efd32.text: eyewitness account, or the result of an accepted scientific method.

f1e35dbc6f43338351fb.text: The penguin is the most unusual bird. It walks upright and cannot fly. I think

383a83549b70389290c5.text: the penguin is the funniest-looking bird in the world. With its black back and white belly, it looks like a small, round waiter wearing a tuxedo. The penguin must be the clumsiest animal on the land. It waddles about on two short legs and webbed feet.

931c62ef180a61b26415.text: Although penguins walk funny and can’t fly, they are excellent swimmers.

f71ce36adf45801434c7.text: Penguins are more graceful in the water than any other sea animal. Instead of wings, penguins have powerful flippers. They help penguins swim underwater at fast speeds.

17382503d8e03022fc62.text: in Antarctica, the coldest place on Earth. Penguins have many layers to protect them from freezing temperatures. Thick layers of fat under thick skin help keep in heat. 17e1953ead8f3cf958e8.text: about four feet high and weighs about 100 pounds. It has a collar of bright orange and yellow feathers around its neck. In 1997, scientists in Antarctica discovered an all-white emperor penguin. So far, this rare penguin in the only one of its kind to be seen.

13ca99d904ab1a62ae43.text: Directions: Read the excerpt from Carmen Guerrero –Nakpil’s “Jeepney” – A Product of Filipino Ingenuity.” Then, pick out facts and opinions you can find about the jeepney stated in the article. Write them in their proper column.

780405251f4641e1c636.text: Jeepney – A Product of Filipino Ingenuity (Excerpt)

420b1b1e44440b71c2e3.text: If one were looking for a symbol of post-war Philippines, one could do no better

b0a0b03e3deb73588479.text: than the jeepney, which is as abundant and as persistent as post-war mosquitoes, and as much as a creature of improvisation1 as the post-war Filipino.

bb1e21a8c7b44b53591b.text: The jeepney, unique in the world, is a tiny bus built by superimposing a shop-

a82ca2b75426673435e0.text: made body on an army jeep. It holds, in addition to its drivers, from six to ten passengers and the most esoteric2 decorating job on wheels. Its body juts out way behind the original chassis and when fully loaded its rear list dangerously close to the asphalt. It looks just as crowded when its carrying four as when it is carrying twelve people – as often does when business is good.

39f6e1138cb4f0bc975b.text: A jeepney is hardly without its painted signs. Beneath the windshield, the

8e68fc5576a6a18d1af3.text: lettering may read Divisoria-Mahal Ko-Pasig I or Manila and Suburbs-Heart and Soul. At the side is inscribed the name of the operator and an imaginative estimate of the passenger capacity. On the steps are more letters: a flirtatious Kiss Me Not or a severe Keep Distance. Jeepney signs are extremely responsive to fad and fashion. They are allusive3, inspirational or romantic, being taken from movie titles, the name of showgirls and actresses or slogans. They undoubtedly add piquancy4 to the traffic problem.

6b82c2a7e01914f5bac4.text: The jeepney’s cramped interior has undergone an even more complete

ab92fc26cd80b5e7e5fc.text: transformation. Above the cracked and dusty windshields, there is usually a strip of mirror, ornamented in the Venetian style, which enables its driver –conductor to keep an eye on the passengers who have not paid their fares. A central place on its reserved for an ikon or print of “Our Lady of Perpetual Help” or “St. Anthony,” with a bunch of dusty paper flowers or a garland of sampaguitas paying tribute to the operator’s favorite devotion. Anyone who has taken a ride in a jeepney will realize how necessary it is to explore the intercession of the saints, the jeepney’s ikon is as traditional as the chapel where bullfighters kneel before the courting death. Having made his obeisance to the Divinity, the jeepney driver proceeds to be as bravo as a matador.

0367b4f471396910b618.text: Improvisation: made up or created without preparation Esoteric: difficult to understand; secret Allusive: root word allusion, which meant to refer to Piquancy: stimulation; spiciness
